title: ServerAtelier
body:
![Headline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/088d9a2842c531c38a65d43847318ae234841d61.png)
[](https://discord.gg/4E57HE4Jqa) [](https://github.com/ServerAtelier/serveratelier-mod/issues)


**ServerAtelier** adds a new button to the main menu that opens an information screen about our professional Minecraft server hosting services. Inside the menu, you'll find: - Our **unique selling points** and what makes ServerAtelier different - A direct **"Get your server"** button that takes you straight to our website This mod is designed to give players an easy, non-intrusive way to discover high-quality server hosting directly from the game. One click is all it takes to learn why Server Atelier is the right choice for your next Minecraft server.

[](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) This mod is developed for Fabric. There are no plans to develop a Forge version. Modpack Permission: Feel free to use it in any modpacks. Bug Report: Just report bugs at the github page.
